title: Landing Gear — Nose Wheel Steering Manifold — Installation of the Fine Filter and Seal Kit
abstract: Installation of a finer manifold filter and a revised seal set in the nose wheel steering actuation, to stop particulate from the later hydraulic pump standard reaching the servo spool and producing steering jitter on the landing roll.

sections.planning_reason: Steering jitter during the landing roll was reported one hundred and six times between 2014 and 2016, concentrated on aircraft that had recently had hydraulic work on the green system. Every servo examined on wing carried fine particulate in the metering lands. The manifold filter rating was chosen for the original pump standard and is too coarse for the debris the later pump generates. Aircraft that are not modified will continue to produce jitter reports after every green system component change, and each report is investigated as a potential steering fault.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin fits a finer element in the steering manifold, replaces the manifold cover seal set and installs a bonded washer at the return port. The accumulator charging port cap is changed to suit the new seal section. The non-return valve is removed, cleaned and refitted, and the position sensor is checked for free movement after the rebuild. No pipework is changed.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Put the aircraft on its wheels with the nose gear down and locked and install the ground locks. Depressurise the green hydraulic system and confirm zero pressure at the gauge. Get access through the nose gear bay in zones 711 and 714. Remove the manifold cover. Remove and discard the existing element and install the fine element D3220123507496. Remove the non-return valve at FIN 2820WS5, clean it in the approved solvent and refit it. Install the new cover seal set and the bonded washer at the return port. Fit the revised charging port cap to the accumulator D3220121572714 and re-charge the accumulator to the value in the instructions. Check that the position sensor at FIN 9WS moves freely through its full travel. Pressurise the green system and check for leaks. Do the nose wheel steering operational test including a full travel sweep in both directions.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to aircraft in the MSN Z00313 to Z06225 range that have not been converted to the standard 3 steering manifold. Aircraft at the standard 3 manifold carry an integrated filter cavity and this bulletin does not apply to them.
sections.material_note: Kit K3220-1251-01 contains the fine element, the cover seal set, the bonded washer and the charging port cap for one aircraft. All items are short-lead. Removed elements are scrap.

type_data.compliance_time: Within 18 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, or at the next green hydraulic system component change, whichever occurs first.
